abstract: PURPOSE: To report the clinical characteristics and intraoperative findings of periorbital and orbital dermoid cysts and their relationship to location and rupture. METHODS: Retrospective review of 270 cases with orbital or periorbital dermoid cysts that presented over a period of 11 years. Patients were included if diagnosis of dermoid cyst was made by histopathologic analysis. Clinical characteristics and operative outcomes were recorded and analyzed with Chi-squared analyses or univariate regression. Multivariate binary logistic regression was performed to assess predictors of location and rupture. RESULTS: Dermoids frequently occurred unilaterally and were more frequently described as mobile (61.5%), followed by fixed (30.8%), and partially fixed (7.7%). Dermoid rigidity was most commonly described as firm (75.5%), followed by cystic, soft, and rubbery. The most common dermoid location was superotemporal (60.4%). On Chi-squared analysis, superotemporal lesions were less likely to have orbital extension than non-superotemporal lesions (OR 0.28, 95% CI: 0.11-0.70, p = .01), less likely to undergo CT (OR 0.16, 95% CI: 0.06-0.41, p < .01) or MRI (OR 0.23, 95% CI: 0.13-0.41, p < .01), more likely to be described as mobile (OR 2.91, 95% CI: 1.32-6.43, p = .01), and less likely to rupture intraoperatively (OR 0.28, 95% CI: 0.11-0.73, p = .01). No variables were associated with rupture in multivariate analysis. CONCLUSION: Superotemporal dermoid cysts are common in the pediatric population, less likely to have orbital extension, undergo imaging, and have intraoperative rupture when compared to other locations in the orbit.
abstract_ja:
目的：眼窩および眼窩周囲の類皮嚢腫の臨床的特徴と術中所見、ならびにその局在および破裂との関連を報告すること。
方法：11年間に受診した眼窩または眼窩周囲の類皮嚢腫270例を後方視的にレビューした。病理組織学的解析により類皮嚢腫と診断された患者を対象とした。臨床的特徴および手術成績を記録し、カイ二乗検定または単変量回帰解析で解析した。局在および破裂の予測因子を評価するため、多変量二項ロジスティック回帰解析を行った。
結果：類皮嚢腫は片側に多く認められ、可動性(61.5%)、次いで固定性(30.8%)、部分固定性(7.7%)と記述されることが多かった。硬さは硬性(75.5%)が最も多く、次いで嚢胞性、軟性、ゴム様であった。最も多い局在は上側頭部(60.4%)であった。カイ二乗解析では、上側頭部病変は非上側頭部病変と比べ、眼窩進展の頻度が低く(OR 0.28、95%CI：0.11-0.70、p=.01)、CT(OR 0.16、95%CI：0.06-0.41、p<.01)またはMRI(OR 0.23、95%CI：0.13-0.41、p<.01)を受ける頻度が低く、可動性と記述される頻度が高く(OR 2.91、95%CI：1.32-6.43、p=.01)、術中破裂の頻度が低かった(OR 0.28、95%CI：0.11-0.73、p=.01)。多変量解析では破裂と関連する変数は認められなかった。
結論：上側頭部の類皮嚢腫は小児に多く、他の眼窩部位と比べ、眼窩進展や画像検査を受ける頻度が低く、術中破裂も少ない。
